format_contract.header: EANM, int32 version>=0x30000, FRMS, int32 positive declared_count, BMAP, int32 bone_count<256
format_contract.bone_record: int32 byte_count then raw name; first _lod truncates name, suffix parsed as integer
format_contract.frmn: int32 coordinate followed by BONE/int32 index and MATR(12float), VISI(int32), MESH(int32 count+bytes) chunks
format_contract.frm2: uint16 coordinate,uint8 update_count; each update:uint8 bone_index,uint16 flags, then optional translation3float, quaternion3float, mesh int32 count+bytes

frm2_flags.0x2: three quaternion components; reconstruct first sqrt(abs(1-sum squares))
frm2_flags.0x4: mirror flag when allocating first-frame track
frm2_flags.0x10: visibility update; hide unless0x8 also set

format_contract.pose_tracks: Every pose update in first stored frame appends track and stores its index in bone68; subsequent frames copy cached poses then update existing tracks. No sorting or late-track allocation observed.

rate_contract.dynamic_points: Start(-1e38,0); each(start,end,factor) replaces last start within epsilon else appends; append(end,0). After loading append(1e38,0), replace rates<=0 by normalized default, require strictly increasing coordinates.
rate_contract.duration_query_from_prior_animation_cont: (binary.last_coordinate+1)/(controller.scale*definition.normalized_rate); not remaining time or a dynamic-speed integral

rotation_contract.shared_once: Sequence parser tests binaryED then attempts rotation and sets ED, even when bone absent. Later definitions sharing cached binary cannot reapply it through this gate.
rotation_contract.limits: Four base declarations request body Z-axis -90deg: two down files have body at bone/track0; two up files contain no body. No mismatch inference for these four; general bone/track-order assumption remains.

resource_scan.limits: Bounded EANM metadata and archive-relative declaration join. No mounted override precedence, iterator order, mesh decoding, interpolation or native playback claimed. Directory matches are an unordered set.
